summary: ansible-core 2.13 templating: arithmetic and concatenation outside the Jinja expression no longer work, the repr of AnsibleUndefined now includes hint, obj and name, and finalize is no longer exposed in template globals.
questions: How do I turn None into an empty string in a template without finalize?
Why does '%r'|format(undefined_var) show more details now?

answer_card.title: Templating changes in ansible-core 2.13
answer_card.answer_md:
- Put all arithmetic/concatenation **inside** the expression:

```yaml
msg: '{{ [1] + [2] }}'   # not '[1] + {{ [2] }}'
```

- `finalize` isn't available in templates. To turn `None` into `''`: `{{ value if value is not none }}`.
- `repr()` of an undefined value is now `AnsibleUndefined(hint=None, obj=missing, name='var')`.
